{"summary":"No BLOCKER or MAJOR prevents WP-19 completion on the selected Email+LINE capability-statement branch. I reviewed only the supplied text, and I could not independently verify the validation receipts (unit/action tests, TypeScript, ESLint, diff check) or the revision hash.

What supports the branch:
- The templates list page, the form copy and the WP-19 doc all say Email and LINE are the selectable channels and SMS is not connected.
- The form shows SMS as a disabled option. The list page labels legacy SMS and unknown channels as "通道不可用" rather than active.
- The schema allows only `email` and `line`, and the action test confirms SMS is rejected before any create, update or audit call.
- The invalid-template message now tells the merchant the channel must be Email or LINE, and the test asserts it.
- The WP-19 doc does not claim provider, metering, opt-out, Sandbox delivery, pricing, billing, schema, queue, Production or actual delivery completion. It marks the EVERY8D items as NOT_RUN or follow-up work.
- The older handoff block in the provider-research doc is labelled historical and points to the WP-19 doc as current.

The findings below are all MINOR or NIT, and none should block acceptance.","findings":[{"issue":"Editing a legacy template whose trigger has no option in the form (order_created, order_paid, commission_credited) may silently change the trigger on save.","required_test":"Render the form with a template whose trigger is order_created. Assert that either the legacy trigger is shown as an unavailable option or an explicit warning appears, and that saving does not change the trigger without the merchant noticing.","area":"Template form / legacy data","impact":"The trigger select is controlled with a value that matches no option, so the browser displays and submits the first option (registration_confirmed). A merchant who only fixes the channel could change the trigger without noticing. This is a pre-existing trigger-handling gap outside the Email+LINE capability statement. The supplied text documents it as a WP-04/WP-13 responsibility.","severity":"MINOR","confidence":0.55,"evidence":"The page's triggerLabels and MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_TRIGGERS include order_created, order_paid and commission_credited. TemplateChannelFields renders only registration_confirmed, live_reminder, live_started, post_live_followup and a disabled cart_followup.","file":"src/components/message-template-form-client.tsx","recommended_fix":"Track this as a follow-up. Render the current legacy trigger as a disabled option with an explanatory label, or add copy telling the merchant to choose a supported trigger."},{"issue":"The form test does not render a legacy SMS template for editing. It tests only the generic invalid_template message.","required_test":"Render MessageTemplateForm with template.channel = 'sms'. Assert that the SMS option is shown as unavailable and that the Email/LINE guidance is visible. Add a client-side check that submitting without choosing Email or LINE yields the invalid_template message.","area":"Test coverage","impact":"The disabled-and-selected SMS case, where the browser omits the select value on submit, is not directly covered. The server-side rejection is covered and the outcome is safe (invalid_template with Email/LINE guidance), so this is only a coverage gap.","severity":"MINOR","confidence":0.5,"evidence":"The tests build the form only with channel: 'email' or 'line'. The SMS cases appear only in the action and message-template unit tests.","file":"src/components/message-template-form.test.tsx","recommended_fix":"Add one render test for a legacy SMS template. Optionally show a pre-submit hint on edit that a legacy SMS template must be moved to Email or LINE."},{"issue":"The form says Email reminder, registration and follow-up templates 'automatically attach an unsubscribe link', and the list-page and form copy says delivery 'depends on the schedule and the provider'. These are behaviour claims whose backing code is not in the supplied text.","required_test":"Reference the existing WP-04 and WP-13 evidence for the unsubscribe-link claim in the WP-19 evidence, or keep the claim limited to template settings.","area":"Copy accuracy","impact":"If the Email unsubscribe-link behaviour regresses, the UI copy would overstate it. The doc already scopes actual delivery and Email trigger behaviour to WP-04/WP-13, so this does not block WP-19.","severity":"NIT","confidence":0.4,"evidence":"The form helper text says 'Email 的報名成功、開播提醒與課後通知會自動附上退訂連結'. The test only checks that the string 課後通知會自動附上退訂連結 appears.","file":"src/components/message-template-form-client.tsx","recommended_fix":"Cite the sending-pipeline test that guarantees the unsubscribe link in the WP-19 evidence, or soften the wording."},{"issue":"The WP-19 doc lists its sources, including line-notification-materializer.ts, but only some of those files were supplied. The 'LINE: registration confirmed, live reminder, live start' claim rests on message-template.ts and the form, which are supplied.","required_test":"Not needed beyond the existing LINE trigger tests.","area":"Documentation evidence","impact":"No contradiction found. The unsupplied source cannot be checked here.","severity":"NIT","confidence":0.3,"evidence":"The doc's 來源 line cites src/lib/line-notification-materializer.ts, which is not in the supplied files.","file":"docs/launch/wp19-notification-channels-20261016.md","recommended_fix":"Ensure the WP evidence bundle includes the cited materializer snapshot."}]}
